title: Delivery & Pickup Appointments Terms: Changing the Delivery Address
content:
On a home delivery booked through Delivery & Pickup Appointments, the delivery address may be changed while the appointment is scheduled, on the conditions below.

## Conditions

1. **Status.** An address is changed only while the appointment status is scheduled. The status is read from the system record of that appointment.
2. **Cutoff.** The change is accepted no later than the fulfillment method's address change cutoff hours before the window start.
3. **Distance from the original address.** The new address is no more than the method's address change maximum distance from the original address.
4. **Service radius.** The new address is still inside the method's service radius.

An accepted change records the new delivery ZIP and the distance from the hub to the new address on the appointment.

**Other changes.** Where the appointment is scheduled but the change fails the cutoff, the distance limit or the service radius, it is not made as an address change. It is handled instead as a cancellation of the appointment and a new booking.

**Pickup methods.** Pickup methods have no delivery address to change.

## Condition table (appointment scheduled)

| Requested no later than the cutoff | New address within the maximum distance of the original | New address inside the service radius | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Address changed |
| No | any | any | Cancellation of the appointment and a new booking |
| any | No | any | Cancellation of the appointment and a new booking |
| any | any | No | Cancellation of the appointment and a new booking |

## Hypothetical boundary cases (cutoff 48 hours, maximum distance 25 miles, service radius 100 miles, window starting 08:00 on a Friday)

- A request at 08:00 on the Wednesday is exactly 48 hours before the window start. If it moves the address 18 miles, to a point 92 miles from the hub, it is accepted as an address change.
- The same request made at 09:00 on the Wednesday is after the cutoff. It is handled as a cancellation and a new booking.
- A request on the Monday that moves the address 30 miles from the original exceeds the 25-mile limit. It is handled as a cancellation and a new booking.
- A request on the Monday that moves the address 10 miles, to a point 104 miles from the hub, falls outside the service radius. It is handled as a cancellation and a new booking.
